open_points.subject: create_budget_schema
open_points.text: - create_budget_schema: [CONFIG_REFERENCE] MUST idempotently create only the tables budget_versions (= config.persistence.budget_version_table_name) and section_plans (= config.persistence.section_plan_table_name), written as fixed names in the SQL text, with columns corresponding one-to-one to BudgetVersion and SectionPlan fields; version_id and plan_id are primary keys, (version_id, section_id) is unique, and nullable model fields remain nullable.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: Must the config.persistence references be removed or supplied through IMPORTS/constants, or are the literal names budget_versions and section_plans authoritative without accessing config?

open_points.subject: SqliteBudgetRepository
open_points.text:
CONCRETE IMPLEMENTATION OBLIGATIONS:
No local concrete-to-interface obligations.
open_points.other_text: - SqliteBudgetRepository.__init__: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST implement only BudgetRepository on the caller-owned SQLite connection; it MUST NOT import application/domain services, create a connection, or commit, rollback, or close the connection.
open_points.question: Must SqliteBudgetRepository implement/inherit BudgetRepository, or must the statement that there are no local concrete-to-interface obligations change?
